NBSAP_1:
"Goal/Purpose": "Reduce biodiversity loss and maintain ecological integrity by 2030.",
"Action/Intervention": "Include all territory in spatial planning; ensure effective management; conduct Red List of Ecosystems assessments; maintain the proportion of natural ecosystems and prevent further decline; integrate biodiversity considerations into general land-use plans and soum territorial development plans; systematically reflect rare fauna, flora, and their habitats in these planning documents.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "All territory; natural ecosystems; land-use planning and soum territorial development planning.",
"Target Audience": "Authorities and planners responsible for spatial planning, land-use plans, soum territorial development plans, and ecosystem management.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Biodiversity loss is reduced, ecological integrity is maintained, the proportion of natural ecosystems is maintained with no further decline, and rare fauna, flora, and their habitats are reflected in planning documents."
NBSAP_2:
"Goal/Purpose": "Restore at least 30 percent of degraded ecosystems by 2030 and improve ecological integrity and connectivity.",
"Action/Intervention": "Restore degraded forest ecosystems; restore land degraded by mining activities; restore degraded land, pastureland and abandoned land; restore water, wetlands, river and lake ecosystems.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Degraded ecosystems, including forest ecosystems, land degraded by mining activities, degraded land, pastureland, abandoned land, and water, wetlands, river and lake ecosystems.",
"Target Audience": "Not explicitly specified in the target.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "At least 30 percent of degraded ecosystems restored by 2030, with improved ecological integrity and connectivity."
NBSAP_3:
"Goal/Purpose": "Include 30% of the country's total area in the special protected area network by 2030, ensuring representation of major ecosystem types and strengthening ecological connectivity.",
"Action/Intervention": "Identify and assess areas under Other Effective area-based Conservation Measures (OECMs); develop, legalize and implement a national protected areas and conservation area strategy and action plan; designate forest, steppe and peatland areas under protection, including representative ecosystems; update the legal framework for protected areas and implement participatory conservation management; increase management effectiveness of protected areas; expand and conserve ecological corridors and connectivity areas; improve management through strengthened transboundary protected area cooperation.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "The country's total area, including forest, steppe and peatland areas, major ecosystem types, protected areas, conservation areas, ecological corridors and connectivity areas.",
"Target Audience": "Protected area and conservation authorities, legal and policy institutions responsible for protected areas, and participants in transboundary protected area cooperation.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "By 2030, 30% of the country's total area is included in the special protected area network, major ecosystem types are represented, and ecological connectivity is strengthened."
NBSAP_4:
"Goal/Purpose": "Reduce the risk of extinction of threatened species and conserve genetic diversity by 2030.",
"Action/Intervention": "Conduct baseline surveys on distribution and abundance; undertake assessments every 5 years in line with the international Red List criteria; protect wildlife migration routes and connectivity areas; increase wildlife-friendly linear infrastructure in line with standards; strengthen the legal framework for biodiversity conservation, sustainable use and reducing biodiversity loss.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Biodiversity conservation, including threatened species, genetic diversity, wildlife migration routes, connectivity areas, and wildlife-friendly linear infrastructure.",
"Target Audience": "Stakeholders responsible for biodiversity conservation, wildlife management, infrastructure planning, and legal and policy frameworks.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Reduced extinction risk for threatened species, conserved genetic diversity, improved protection of migration routes and connectivity areas, increased wildlife-friendly infrastructure, and strengthened legal support for biodiversity conservation and sustainable use."
NBSAP_5:
"Goal/Purpose": "To register, control, and assess the impacts of invasive alien species, and build capacity to combat and prevent their adverse effects by 2030.",
"Action/Intervention": "Strengthen the legal and policy framework related to alien species; undertake research and establish a registry/database on alien species; assess risks, develop response plans, and strengthen capacity; register, control, and assess the impacts of invasive alien species; build capacity to combat and prevent their adverse effects.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Alien species / invasive alien species management",
"Target Audience": "Not explicitly specified in the target or implementation activities.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Invasive alien species are registered, controlled, and their impacts assessed; capacity is strengthened to combat and prevent their adverse effects by 2030."
NBSAP_6:
"Goal/Purpose": "Reduce pollution from all sources by 2030 to levels that are not harmful to biodiversity, ecosystem functions, and human health.",
"Action/Intervention": "Promote sound pesticide use; establish a pesticide tracking system; introduce alternatives to chemical pesticides; identify soil contaminated by pesticide residues; strengthen laboratory capacity to determine soil pesticide residues; remediate soil contaminated by pesticides; adopt international IPSM standards; improve economic instruments for waste management; establish legal provisions based on extended producer responsibility and the polluter-pays principle; establish temporary hazardous waste storage facilities; translate and approve ISO standards on micro- and macroplastics in the environment; prohibit the import and use in Mongolia of chemicals newly added to Annex III of the Rotterdam Convention.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Biodiversity, ecosystem functions, human health, soil, waste management, hazardous waste, and micro- and macroplastics in the environment.",
"Target Audience": "Implementing authorities in pesticide management, soil contamination monitoring and remediation, waste management, hazardous waste management, standards approval, and chemical import and use regulation in Mongolia; and beneficiaries affected by biodiversity, ecosystem functions, and human health.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Pollution from all sources is reduced to levels that are not harmful to biodiversity, ecosystem functions, and human health by 2030."
NBSAP_7:
"Goal/Purpose": "Minimize the impact of climate change on biodiversity and increase its resilience by 2030.",
"Action/Intervention": "Undertake mitigation, adaptation, and disaster risk reduction actions through nature-based solutions and ecosystem-based approaches; conduct and expand long-term monitoring and establish monitoring points for climate change; increase carbon sequestration by expanding forest cover; strengthen risk assessment, early warning systems, and local preparedness under the Sendai Framework; integrate nature-based solutions into disaster risk management to reduce climate-related disaster risks.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Biodiversity; climate change; forests; disaster risk management.",
"Target Audience": "Not explicitly specified in the target.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Reduced impact of climate change on biodiversity, increased resilience of biodiversity, increased carbon sequestration, and reduced climate-related disaster risks."
NBSAP_8:
"Goal/Purpose": "By 2030, reduce ecosystem degradation by supporting the development of sustainable, highly productive forestry and agriculture, while introducing nature-based practices.",
"Action/Intervention": "Support the development of sustainable, highly productive forestry and agriculture and introduce nature-based practices through: strengthening accountability systems by enabling contractual pasture use through primary herder groups; conducting pasture-use assessments; developing a methodology to determine pasture carrying capacity considering overlap between livestock and wild herbivore grazing; developing suitable methodologies to estimate greenhouse gas emissions from pastoral livestock production; protecting cropland soil from erosion and degradation and implementing response measures; reducing fertilizer and pesticide use through smart technologies; reducing chemical plant protection inputs by promoting mixed cropping; establishing shelterbelts on cropland; identifying agricultural lands negatively affecting biodiversity; and diversifying and developing model forestry/agroforestry.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Forestry, agriculture, pastureland, and cropland.",
"Target Audience": "Primary herder groups and actors involved in forestry, agriculture, pasture management, and cropland management.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Reduced ecosystem degradation by 2030, with more sustainable and highly productive forestry and agriculture, increased use of nature-based practices, protected cropland soil, reduced fertilizer, pesticide, and chemical plant protection inputs, established shelterbelts on cropland, identification of agricultural lands negatively affecting biodiversity, and diversified model forestry/agroforestry."
NBSAP_9:
"Goal/Purpose": "Increase the benefits of nature to people through ecosystem services derived from nature-based solutions by 2030.",
"Action/Intervention": "Use ecosystem services valuation in policy, land use and sector planning to restore nature’s benefits in real terms; reduce sources of air pollution; improve air quality monitoring; increase secure sources of drinking water for the population and promote efficient use; implement nature-based solutions that provide ecosystem services.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Nature-based solutions, ecosystem services, policy and land use planning, air quality, and drinking water.",
"Target Audience": "The population; policymakers and planners involved in policy, land use and sector planning.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Increased benefits of nature to people through ecosystem services; restored nature’s benefits in real terms; reduced air pollution; improved air quality monitoring; increased secure sources of drinking water and more efficient water use by 2030."
NBSAP_10:
"Goal/Purpose": "Increase the area of urban green and blue infrastructure by 2030.",
"Action/Intervention": "Conduct campaigns for maintenance and protection of green and blue infrastructure; increase per capita urban green space to international benchmarks; organize citizen-based tree planting and maintenance campaigns; create artificial lakes and water features; integrate green/blue infrastructure into urban master plans and partial development plans; establish new urban forests, parks and green spaces.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Urban areas; urban green and blue infrastructure.",
"Target Audience": "Urban authorities/planners and citizens.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Expanded area of urban green and blue infrastructure by 2030, including increased per capita urban green space and the establishment and maintenance of urban forests, parks, green spaces, lakes, and water features."
NBSAP_11:
"Goal/Purpose": "To develop a comprehensive database for genetic resources and traditional knowledge by 2030, while strengthening legal and governance frameworks to ensure the fair and equitable sharing of benefits.",
"Action/Intervention": "Create the legal framework for benefit-sharing from the utilization of genetic resources and associated traditional knowledge; strengthen and enrich the electronic registry on the use of genetic resources and associated traditional knowledge; establish and develop a digital gene bank database, including detailed records of samples/specimens held in various collections and sequence information; translate and approve a series of biobank standards; establish a seed bank for wild plants; undertake genetic evaluation of high-value livestock breeds and establish a database; improve the legal framework governing conservation, storage, use, commercialization and benefit-sharing of food and agricultural crop genetic resources.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Genetic resources and associated traditional knowledge, including biobanks, seed banks, livestock genetic resources, and food and agricultural crop genetic resources.",
"Target Audience": "Entities responsible for managing, regulating, conserving, storing, using, commercializing, and documenting genetic resources and associated traditional knowledge.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "A comprehensive database for genetic resources and traditional knowledge is developed, and stronger legal and governance frameworks are in place to support fair and equitable benefit-sharing from their utilization."
NBSAP_12:
"Goal/Purpose": "Integrate biodiversity issues into the policies and planning of all sectors by 2030.",
"Action/Intervention": "Integrate biodiversity conservation, sustainable use and restoration into medium- and short-term planning at all levels; apply the One Health approach in food, agriculture, health and environment sector planning and implementation; undertake social and environmental impact assessments for policies, projects and programmes at all levels; organize phased trainings and outreach for decision-makers and professionals across sectors on biodiversity conservation, sustainable use and restoration.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "All sectors; food, agriculture, health and environment sector planning and implementation; policies, projects and programmes at all levels.",
"Target Audience": "Decision-makers and professionals across sectors.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Biodiversity issues are integrated into policies and planning of all sectors by 2030."
NBSAP_13:
"Goal/Purpose": "To establish systems by 2030 to monitor and transparently report the impacts, risks, and outcomes of business activities regarding biodiversity.",
"Action/Intervention": "Establish monitoring and transparent reporting systems for business impacts, risks, and outcomes regarding biodiversity; create an incentive system to support biodiversity-friendly start-ups; develop and introduce financial products dedicated to biodiversity conservation; assess contributions of businesses to conservation and increase the number of enterprises eligible for tax incentives; adopt international sustainability standards, including standards for reporting environmental impacts under international financial reporting frameworks.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Business activities regarding biodiversity.",
"Target Audience": "Businesses, biodiversity-friendly start-ups, enterprises eligible for tax incentives, and entities applying international sustainability and environmental reporting standards.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Systems are established by 2030 to monitor and transparently report biodiversity-related impacts, risks, and outcomes of business activities; increased support for biodiversity-friendly businesses through incentives, financial products, tax incentives, and adoption of international reporting standards."
NBSAP_14:
"Goal/Purpose": "To minimize overconsumption and waste by 2030 through supporting public education on sustainable consumption.",
"Action/Intervention": "Support public education on sustainable consumption; develop ecological footprint accounting using international standard methodologies and establish a database; promote conscious purchasing and the use of nature-friendly products and services through behavioural change campaigns; promote zero waste and circular economy values through traditional nomadic culture and nature-friendly practices; support sustainable consumption initiatives to reduce food waste; promote household and institutional practices for water and energy saving and greywater reuse; integrate biodiversity, climate change and sustainable development content into general, technical/vocational and higher education curricula.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Sustainable consumption, waste, education, household and institutional resource use, food waste, water and energy use, and circular economy.",
"Target Audience": "The public; households and institutions; learners in general, technical/vocational and higher education.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Reduced overconsumption and waste; increased public education and awareness on sustainable consumption; reduced food waste; increased conscious purchasing and use of nature-friendly products and services; greater adoption of zero waste, circular economy, water-saving, energy-saving and greywater reuse practices."
NBSAP_15:
"Goal/Purpose": "To enhance the legislative, governance, and monitoring systems for genetically modified organisms by 2030.",
"Action/Intervention": "Improve the legal and policy framework on LMOs; establish a national biosafety clearing-house information system; develop and approve a package of MNS standards for LMO risk assessment; conduct baseline studies and risk assessments of genetically modified crop plants; accredit laboratories capable of LMO detection and risk assessment and strengthen technical and human capacities; improve LMO monitoring and import control.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Genetically modified organisms (LMOs), biosafety, and genetically modified crop plants.",
"Target Audience": "Institutions and bodies responsible for LMO legislation, governance, monitoring, biosafety information management, laboratory accreditation, risk assessment, and import control.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Enhanced legal and policy framework, governance arrangements, monitoring systems, biosafety information system, approved risk assessment standards, completed baseline studies and risk assessments for genetically modified crop plants, accredited LMO detection and risk assessment laboratories, strengthened technical and human capacities, and improved LMO monitoring and import control by 2030."
NBSAP_16:
"Goal/Purpose": "To reform subsidies and incentives that have negative impacts on biodiversity by 2030, while increasing environmentally positive (green) incentives.",
"Action/Intervention": "Ensure intersectoral coordination in subsidy and incentive policy planning; conduct environmental monitoring and evaluation of subsidies and incentives; repurpose potentially harmful subsidies and incentives in the agriculture sector, energy sector, and transport sector; revise up to five regulations and policies on harmful subsidies and incentives using green criteria; increase environmentally positive (green) incentives.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Biodiversity; subsidy and incentive policy; agriculture sector; energy sector; transport sector.",
"Target Audience": "Sectors and institutions involved in subsidy and incentive policy planning, monitoring, evaluation, and reform, including those in agriculture, energy, and transport.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Subsidies and incentives with negative impacts on biodiversity are reformed, environmentally positive (green) incentives are increased, potentially harmful subsidies and incentives in agriculture, energy, and transport are repurposed, and up to five regulations and policies on harmful subsidies and incentives are revised using green criteria."
NBSAP_17:
"Goal/Purpose": "To substantially and progressively increase financial resources towards biodiversity conservation from all sources in an effective, timely, innovative and easily accessible manner.",
"Action/Intervention": "Increase private sector financing for biodiversity within biodiversity finance systems and environmental and social responsibility frameworks; raise public expenditure on the environment sector to internationally comparable levels as a share of GDP; adopt the revised Law on Natural Resource Use Fees and strengthen implementation; transition total environmental sector financing to results-based budgeting; comprehensively upgrade the budget and expenditure database for environmental protection and restoration measures by linking it with databases and systems of other government agencies; establish the legal basis to collect a 'Nature Benefit Fee' from foreign citizens and allocate it to biodiversity conservation; increase conservation revenues by strengthening the legal framework and implementation of biodiversity offsetting; study and pilot biodiversity credits and other innovative mechanisms for biodiversity action.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Biodiversity conservation; environment sector; environmental protection and restoration measures.",
"Target Audience": "Private sector actors; public sector/government agencies responsible for environment financing, budgeting, legal frameworks, and database systems; foreign citizens subject to the 'Nature Benefit Fee'.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Substantially and progressively increased financial resources for biodiversity conservation from all sources, with financing delivered in an effective, timely, innovative and easily accessible manner; increased conservation revenues; higher public expenditure on the environment sector; and strengthened financing mechanisms, legal frameworks, budgeting, and expenditure tracking for biodiversity action."
NBSAP_18:
"Goal/Purpose": "To strengthen capacity-building and development, access to and transfer of technology, and to promote the development of and access to innovation and technical and scientific cooperation in biodiversity conservation.",
"Action/Intervention": "Increase the number and financing of projects supported by the Science and Technology Fund for biodiversity conservation; strengthen cooperation among government, private sector and international programmes to expand innovation and technical cooperation in the environment sector; support environmental sector professionals and provide scholarships for students and researchers; upgrade research laboratories and equipment in the environment sector, improve accessibility, and strengthen monitoring and human resource capacity.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Biodiversity conservation and the environment sector.",
"Target Audience": "Government, private sector, international programmes, environmental sector professionals, students, researchers, and institutions in the environment sector.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Increased capacity-building and development; improved access to and transfer of technology; expanded innovation and technical and scientific cooperation in biodiversity conservation; increased number and financing of biodiversity conservation projects; strengthened monitoring, research infrastructure, accessibility, and human resource capacity."
NBSAP_19:
"Goal/Purpose": "To ensure that by 2030, data and information relevant to biodiversity and ecosystem services are widely accessible to decision makers, scientists and the public in order to guide effective and equitable governance and integrated and participatory management of biodiversity.",
"Action/Intervention": "Make biodiversity- and ecosystem services-related data and information widely accessible; conduct trainings and outreach to promote sustainable use of natural resources, associated traditional knowledge related to genetic resources, prevention of illegal wildlife and plant trade, and awareness on LMOs and alien species; increase access to information and conduct trainings and outreach among customs, judiciary, prosecutors, environmental police and relevant public officials on prevention of illegal wildlife and plant trade and environmental crimes and offences; promote nature-based solutions and green technologies through multi-stakeholder outreach and encourage active participation; broadcast environmental news, information and educational programmes for at least 2 per cent of total airtime on Mongolia’s national public radio and television; organize multi-stakeholder campaigns on environmentally friendly green technologies and encourage participation; systematically incorporate information on the value and importance of biodiversity into editorial policies of media outlets and strengthen journalists’ capacity; establish a master’s programme in environmental journalism and train specialized journalists.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Biodiversity and ecosystem services; governance, biodiversity management, environmental information and communication.",
"Target Audience": "Decision makers, scientists, the public, customs, judiciary, prosecutors, environmental police, relevant public officials, media outlets, journalists, and multi-stakeholder participants.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Data and information relevant to biodiversity and ecosystem services are widely accessible by 2030, and this information guides effective and equitable governance and integrated and participatory management of biodiversity."
NBSAP_20:
"Goal/Purpose": "Ensure by 2030 full, equitable, inclusive, effective, and gender-responsive representation and participation in biodiversity-related decision-making and implementation, and ensure rights over relevant resources of local communities, women and girls, and youth.",
"Action/Intervention": "Organize annual regional trainings on women’s participation and leadership in environmental sector decision-making; undertake research and develop recommendations on the linkages between biodiversity, traditional conservation knowledge and gender; build the capacity of local communities, women and youth engaged in nature-dependent businesses by supporting nature-friendly good practices; strengthen the knowledge and capacity of institutions implementing the biodiversity strategy and action plan to use sex-disaggregated data in policy and planning and to develop and apply gender-responsive indicators; ensure representation and participation in biodiversity-related decision-making and implementation; ensure rights over relevant resources for local communities, women and girls, and youth.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Biodiversity and the environmental sector.",
"Target Audience": "Local communities, women and girls, youth, institutions implementing the biodiversity strategy and action plan, and participants in biodiversity-related decision-making and implementation.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Full, equitable, inclusive, effective, and gender-responsive representation and participation in biodiversity-related decision-making and implementation by 2030, strengthened institutional use of sex-disaggregated data and gender-responsive indicators, improved capacity of local communities, women and youth engaged in nature-dependent businesses, and ensured rights over relevant resources for local communities, women and girls, and youth."
NAP_1:
"Goal/Purpose": "Support climate change adaptation across all sectors by enhancing policies, legal structures, and organizational capacities.",
"Action/Intervention": "Enhance policies, legal structures, and organizational capacities; establish legal regulations to ensure integrated coordination for reducing disaster risks induced by climate, water, and weather and for adapting to climate change; improve intersectoral coordination; approve and ensure implementation of the National Biodiversity programme and Plan.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "All sectors; climate change adaptation; disaster risk reduction related to climate, water, and weather; biodiversity.",
"Target Audience": "Sectors and organizations involved in climate change adaptation, disaster risk reduction, intersectoral coordination, and implementation of the National Biodiversity programme and Plan.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Improved support for climate change adaptation across all sectors; integrated coordination for reducing climate-, water-, and weather-induced disaster risks; improved intersectoral coordination; approved and implemented National Biodiversity programme and Plan."
NAP_2:
"Goal/Purpose": "Improve climate change adaptation knowledge and capacity among stakeholders.",
"Action/Intervention": "Conduct research; provide training; disseminate information; identify social groups vulnerable to climate change and study the dynamics of their livelihoods; organize capacity development activities at the national level to educate and provide information on climate change risks and adaptation measures to government employees and populations vulnerable to climate change.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Climate change adaptation.",
"Target Audience": "Stakeholders; government employees; populations vulnerable to climate change; social groups vulnerable to climate change.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Improved knowledge and capacity on climate change adaptation among stakeholders, including increased education and information on climate change risks and adaptation measures."
NAP_3:
"Goal/Purpose": "Improve the adaptive capacity of ecosystems and biodiversity",
"Action/Intervention": "Take under special protection and improve management of at least 35 percent of each main representative ecosystems, and entire ecosystems that are unique and vulnerable to climate change; establish a comprehensive surveillance and control system for changes in the population number, habitat, and species migration of wild animals due to climate change",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Ecosystems and biodiversity, including main representative ecosystems, unique and climate-vulnerable ecosystems, and wild animal habitats",
"Target Audience": "Not explicitly provided",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "At least 35 percent of each main representative ecosystem is under special protection and improved management; entire unique and climate-vulnerable ecosystems are protected and better managed; a comprehensive system is established to monitor and control changes in wild animal population number, habitat, and species migration due to climate change"
NAP_4:
"Goal/Purpose": "Reduce desertification, land degradation, and permafrost loss.",
"Action/Intervention": "Reduce the area of land affected by desertification and degradation by implementing actions to protect and increase water resources; establish forest strips suitable to the geographical location and regional features in areas affected by desertification; take peatlands under special state protection; promote rehabilitation and sustainable use of degraded lands.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Areas affected by desertification, degraded lands, peatlands, and permafrost areas.",
"Target Audience": "State authorities and land managers in areas affected by desertification, degraded lands, peatlands, and permafrost areas.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Reduced area of land affected by desertification and degradation, increased protection of peatlands, rehabilitation and sustainable use of degraded lands, and reduced permafrost loss."
NAP_5:
"Goal/Purpose": "Establish a continuous water monitoring system using advanced technology for sustainable management.",
"Action/Intervention": "Establish a monitoring network for water quality and water resource replenishment of underground water replenishment facilities, using advanced technology.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Water resources, including water quality and underground water replenishment facilities.",
"Target Audience": "Not explicitly specified.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Continuous monitoring of water quality and water resource replenishment for sustainable management."
NAP_6:
"Goal/Purpose": "Strengthen water ecosystem services by conserving and restoring water resources, and utilizing technology to boost surface water.",
"Action/Intervention": "Conserve and restore water resources; utilize technology to boost surface water; accumulate a total of 6.4 km3 of water resources through surface water collection; build ponds for hay and crop irrigation; build ponds for breeding of fish and aquatic animals; create overfloading sites by constructing traditional small-scale ponds to solve water supply of wildlife and livestock.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Water resources and water ecosystem services.",
"Target Audience": "Wildlife, livestock, and users of water for hay and crop irrigation and for breeding fish and aquatic animals.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "A total of 6.4 km3 of water resources accumulated through surface water collection, and improved water supply for wildlife, livestock, hay and crop irrigation, and breeding of fish and aquatic animals."
NAP_7:
"Goal/Purpose": "Establish sustainable forest management, climate-resilient natural forests, and better re/afforestation capacity.",
"Action/Intervention": "Establish a forest seed bank and supply reproductive materials; implement the national movement on reforestation and afforestation, including urban areas; carry out sustainable forest management and protection.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Forests and urban areas related to reforestation and afforestation.",
"Target Audience": "Not explicitly provided in the target or associated actions/measures.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Sustainable forest management established, climate-resilient natural forests developed, and re/afforestation capacity improved."
NAP_8:
"Goal/Purpose": "Minimize risks from climate change induced disasters and improve resilience",
"Action/Intervention": "Develop a database for weather and climate change disasters, risks, damage, risk insurance information, and data sharing management; improve the insurance system to reduce climate and hydrometeorological hazards and disaster risks.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Climate change disaster risk and hydrometeorological hazard management",
"Target Audience": "Stakeholders involved in disaster risk management, weather and climate disaster data management, and insurance systems",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Reduced risks from climate change induced disasters, reduced climate and hydrometeorological hazard and disaster risks, and improved resilience"
NAP_9:
"Goal/Purpose": "To develop multi-hazard, impact-based early warning systems that enable quick and effective responses to extreme events.",
"Action/Intervention": "Increase the forecasting and computing capacity of supercomputers; provide early warning of catastrophic events; improve the spatial and temporal accuracy, probability, and accuracy of forecasting; establish and introduce an early warning system based on multiple impacts, including drought, dzud, flood, strong wind, heavy snow, and rain, at the urban and regional level.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Early warning systems for extreme events at the urban and regional level.",
"Target Audience": "Urban and regional-level stakeholders and those responding to or affected by extreme events.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Quick and effective responses to extreme events, supported by improved forecasting capacity and greater spatial and temporal forecasting accuracy."
NAP_10:
"Goal/Purpose": "Foster sustainable livestock management that aligns with water and pasture resources and is climate-resilient.",
"Action/Intervention": "Set the boundaries of the winter-spring pastures of herders and their communities; ensure the management of the long-term use of the pastures by the herders; establish water points, wells and ponds to improve the water supply of pastures.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Livestock management in pasture areas, including winter-spring pastures and their water resources.",
"Target Audience": "Herders and their communities.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Sustainable livestock management aligned with available water and pasture resources, improved water supply of pastures, managed long-term pasture use, and climate-resilient livestock management."
NAP_11:
"Goal/Purpose": "Improve livestock quality, reduce pasture overuse, and develop value chains for marketable livestock products.",
"Action/Intervention": "Develop marketing strategies to enhance the sale of livestock and livestock products; introduce technologies to track the registry of origin and movement of livestock; establish protected farms with veterinary quarantine; reduce the number of livestock suffering from emerging and resurgent veterinary diseases.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Livestock sector, pasture management, and livestock product value chains.",
"Target Audience": "Livestock producers and actors involved in livestock and livestock product marketing and management.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Enhanced sale of livestock and livestock products, improved livestock traceability and disease control, reduced pasture overuse, and strengthened value chains for marketable livestock products."
NAP_12:
"Goal/Purpose": "Sustainably develop high-yield crops through climate-adapted technologies and soil conservation.",
"Action/Intervention": "Increase the number of crop rotations that are beneficial for soil fertility and economically efficient; reduce the percentage of black fallow; increase the cultivation of leguminous and other food and fodder crops; build reservoirs, marshes, and ponds to use snow and rain flood water for improving water supply and use it for irrigation of fodder crops, potatoes, and vegetables; grow a forest strip on agricultural fields fenced off by farmers; apply climate-adapted technologies and soil conservation measures.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Agricultural fields and crop production systems.",
"Target Audience": "Farmers.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "High-yield crops are developed sustainably, with improved soil fertility, improved water supply for irrigation, increased cultivation of leguminous and other food and fodder crops, reduced black fallow, and establishment of forest strips on agricultural fields."
NAP_13:
"Goal/Purpose": "Protect and sustain soil fertility through climate-smart agricultural practices.",
"Action/Intervention": "Introduction of crops and varieties resistant to drought, diseases and pests, and improvement of seed supply of varieties.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Agriculture; soil",
"Target Audience": "Not explicitly specified",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Protected and sustained soil fertility"
NAP_14:
"Goal/Purpose": "Mitigate climate-related health risks.",
"Action/Intervention": "Enhance research, preparedness, and capacity-building, and develop evidence-based public health recommendations versus climate change-induced morbidity and mortality.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Public health and climate change.",
"Target Audience": "Public health sector.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Evidence-based public health recommendations addressing climate change-induced morbidity and mortality, contributing to reduced climate-related health risks."
NAP_15:
"Goal/Purpose": "To reduce the vulnerability of communities by creating social safety nets, protection systems, and insurance mechanisms.",
"Action/Intervention": "Create social safety nets, protection systems, and insurance mechanisms; engage target groups vulnerable to climate change, and people migrated to urban areas due to loss of their livelihood sources through natural disasters, in occupational orientation training.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Communities affected by climate change and natural disasters, including urban areas receiving people who migrated due to loss of livelihood sources.",
"Target Audience": "Communities vulnerable to climate change; people migrated to urban areas due to loss of their livelihood sources through natural disasters.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Reduced vulnerability of communities."
NDC_28:
"Goal/Purpose": "Reduce total GHG emissions (excluding LULUCF) compared to the Business as Usual (BAU) scenario by 2030 and 2035.",
"Action/Intervention": "Implement unconditional measures under national and sectoral development policies and plans.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "National and sectoral development policies and plans; GHG emissions excluding LULUCF.",
"Target Audience": "Not explicitly specified in the target.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Total GHG emissions (excluding LULUCF) could be reduced by 23.0% by 2030 and 30.3% by 2035 compared to the BAU scenario, corresponding to a reduction of 16.0 million t CO₂-eq. in 2030 and 24.7 million t CO₂-eq. in 2035."
NDC_29:
"Goal/Purpose": "Increase forest sequestration by 2035 beyond the business-as-usual GHG absorption scenario.",
"Action/Intervention": "Implement measures aimed at increasing forest sequestration.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Forest sector; GHG absorption and sequestration.",
"Target Audience": "Not explicitly provided in the target.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Forest sequestration could reach -24.4 million t CO₂-eq. by 2035 instead of the BAU estimate of -21.1 million t CO₂-eq., allowing an additional approximately 3.3 million t CO₂-eq. to be absorbed through enhanced sequestration."
NDC_30:
"Goal/Purpose": "Reduce net GHG emissions compared to the BAU scenario by 2030 and 2035 through reducing GHG emissions from sources and increasing GHG sequestration.",
"Action/Intervention": "Successfully implement measures to reduce GHG emissions from sources and increase GHG sequestration.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "GHG emissions and sequestration",

NDC_4:
{
  "Goal/Purpose": "Enhance the resilience of the water sector through the utilization of advanced technologies for conservation, restoration, sustainable use and secure water availability.",

regulate the thermal regime of water through riparian forestation and monitor its effectiveness; restore and expand surface–groundwater interaction monitoring networks and water balance assessment systems; implement projects in arid and semi-arid regions through partnerships between local governments, the private sector, the mining industry, and light and heavy industry to establish Managed Aquifer Recharge systems, covered reservoirs, and infiltration wells for groundwater replenishment; in cool and moderately humid zones, construct irrigation ponds for hay and crop cultivation, fish and aquatic species breeding ponds, and community ponds, develop natural overflow systems, and deliver water through canals and pipelines to wildlife and livestock in semi-arid and arid areas; support pasture irrigation and household water use by delivering water to drying endorheic lakes, enabling cultivation of berries, vegetables, and household-level fish farming; regulate the thermal regime of river and lake waters through shading from riparian forests, implement ecosystem protection measures, and support breeding of native fish species such as taimen, lenok, Arctic grayling, and other indigenous aquatic species; conditionally retain the projected 6.4 km³ of meltwater in upstream basins of rivers such as Khovd, Bulgan, Kharkhiraa, Turgun, Zuil, Khushoot, Namir, Bayan, and Gorkhon; conditionally develop feasibility studies for Orkhon-Gobi and Shuren Hydropower Plants for hydropower generation and flow transfer from the Selenge and Orkhon River Basins to the Gobi region; conditionally establish water accumulation zones in low-evaporation areas such as the upper and middle reaches of the Baidrag, Ongi, Taats, Ar-Aguit, and Tuin river basins, address water supply issues along these rivers, restore and protect ecosystems of Ulaan, Orog, Taatsiin Tsagaan, and Khaya lakes and associated wetlands, and develop infrastructure and capacity to regulate lake water regimes.",
  "Ecosystem/Area": "Water sector; river headwaters; groundwater systems and wells; glaciers, lakes, reservoirs, rivers, wetlands, and associated aquatic ecosystems; humid, sub-humid, cool, moderately humid, semi-arid, and arid regions; upstream river basins and low-evaporation water accumulation zones.",

}
