FSS_10:
"Goal/Purpose": "To restructure state-owned universities and professional-vocational training centres in the fields of food, agriculture and light industry, modernise their organisational structure, improve the quality of training, provide tuition fee support for students in these priority areas, enhance the skills of qualified professionals, create stable working conditions for professional personnel, and ensure the necessary funding is included in national and local budgets.",
"Action/Intervention": "Reform the structure and organisation of relevant universities and colleges; modernise the organisational structure of state-owned universities and professional-vocational training centres in the fields of food, agriculture and light industry; improve the quality of training for staff in the food, agriculture and light industry sectors; provide tuition fee support for students in priority areas in these sectors; enhance the skills of qualified professionals; create stable working conditions for professional personnel; include the necessary funding in national and local budgets; organise the provision of general guidance on food safety; and arrange for staff to undergo refresher training.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "State-owned universities and professional-vocational training centres in the fields of food, agriculture and light industry, including food-related activities and food safety training.",
"Target Audience": "State-owned universities and professional-vocational training centres; staff and qualified professionals in the food, agriculture and light industry sectors; students in priority areas in these sectors; operators of food-related activities; and professional personnel.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Improved organisational structure of relevant universities and training centres, improved quality of training, tuition fee support provided to students in priority areas, enhanced skills of qualified professionals and staff, stable working conditions for professional personnel, refresher training and food safety guidance organised for food-related staff, and necessary funding included in national and local budgets."
FSS_11:
"Goal/Purpose": "To ensure a stable supply of the infrastructure, energy, steam, heat and fuel sources required to guarantee food supply and safety and to increase domestic production of food products that replace imports.",
"Action/Intervention": "Establish regulations to reduce or exempt the costs of steam and heat usage for major food producers and greenhouse farms; organise measures to ensure the stable supply of fuel and energy in order to maintain the continuity of agricultural production; where necessary, establish and implement arrangements to subsidise or exempt the electricity costs of staple food producers.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Food production and agricultural production, including greenhouse farming and staple food production.",
"Target Audience": "Major food producers, greenhouse farms, staple food producers, and those responsible for organising energy and fuel supply measures and cost regulations.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Stable supply of infrastructure, energy, steam, heat and fuel for food production; continuity of agricultural production; guaranteed food supply and safety; increased domestic production of food products that replace imports."
FSS_12:
"Goal/Purpose": "To revive, promote and introduce traditional food preparation methods and technologies, adapted to the unique natural, geographical and climatic characteristics of Mongolia, into everyday use, and to establish and support a system for creating innovative products based on traditional food preparation knowledge.",
"Action/Intervention": "Organise research and analysis to revive and introduce traditional food preparation methods and technologies adapted to the natural, geographical and climatic characteristics of Mongolia; promote and introduce these methods and technologies into everyday use; establish and support a system for creating innovative products based on traditional food preparation knowledge; support the creation of branded products by developing distinctive goods using traditional Mongolian technologies; establish a national Mongolian food and beverage network.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Food preparation, food and beverage sector, and traditional knowledge in Mongolia.",
"Target Audience": "Producers of traditional and innovative food products, and participants in the national Mongolian food and beverage network.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Traditional food preparation methods and technologies are revived, promoted and used in everyday practice; a system for creating innovative products based on traditional food preparation knowledge is established and supported; branded and distinctive products using traditional Mongolian technologies are created; and a national Mongolian food and beverage network is established."
FSS_13:
"Goal/Purpose": "To support citizens and businesses that have relocated from the capital to rural areas to engage in livestock farming and agriculture, in order to ensure a balance between urban and rural development and to curb centralisation.",
"Action/Intervention": "Organise the provision of preferential loans from the Local Small and Medium Enterprises Development Fund to individuals and businesses engaged in food-related activities who have relocated from the capital to local areas, to support their engagement in livestock farming and agriculture.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Rural areas; livestock farming; agriculture; food-related activities; urban and rural development",
"Target Audience": "Citizens and businesses that have relocated from the capital to rural/local areas, particularly those engaged in food-related activities, livestock farming, and agriculture",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Support for relocated citizens and businesses to engage in livestock farming and agriculture, contributing to a balance between urban and rural development and helping to curb centralisation."
FSS_14:
"Goal/Purpose": "To create opportunities to introduce and promote domestically produced branded products at international and regional exhibitions and trade fairs, and to establish and support the legal framework for their export.",
"Action/Intervention": "Provide opportunities to introduce and promote brand products manufactured in Mongolia at international and regional exhibitions and trade fairs; establish and support the legal framework for export of domestically produced branded products; select and reward the top 100 producers in the food and agriculture sector; promote and raise awareness of the ‘Food Supply and Safety’ national movement.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Domestic branded products export promotion; food and agriculture sector; international and regional exhibitions and trade fairs.",
"Target Audience": "Producers of domestically produced branded products in Mongolia, including producers in the food and agriculture sector.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Increased opportunities for Mongolian branded products to be introduced and promoted at international and regional exhibitions and trade fairs, strengthened legal support for their export, recognition of top producers in the food and agriculture sector, and increased awareness of the ‘Food Supply and Safety’ national movement."
FSS_15:
"Goal/Purpose": "Improve the use of agricultural land, increase plot sizes, bring the area under rotation to 1.1 million hectares, increase irrigated cropland by 5,000 hectares, and align agricultural land with the national land-use planning scheme.",
"Action/Intervention": "Convert up to 200,000 hectares of newly reclaimed land into agricultural land; update indicators of farmland status, soil fertility, erosion and degradation; convert virgin land into arable land based on a suitability study; increase the area of irrigated wheat cultivation by 5,000 hectares.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Agricultural land, including newly reclaimed land, virgin land, arable land, irrigated cropland, and land covered by the national land-use planning scheme.",
"Target Audience": "Agricultural land users and entities responsible for agricultural land management and land-use planning.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Up to 200,000 hectares of newly reclaimed land converted into agricultural land; area under rotation brought to 1.1 million hectares; irrigated cropland increased by 5,000 hectares; agricultural land aligned with the national land-use planning scheme; updated indicators on farmland status, soil fertility, erosion and degradation."
FSS_16:
"Goal/Purpose": "Utilisation and protection of plant genetic resources; establishment of a seed reserve for locally adapted varieties; creation of a system for the production of seeds of cereals, potatoes, vegetables, fruits, berries and other useful crops; establishment at the national level of 15 seed farms; and development of variety testing activities on a scientific basis.",
"Action/Intervention": "Support the development of new crop varieties, their acclimatisation and testing, the production of elite certified seeds of these varieties, and the implementation of scientific and technological projects; support the establishment of primary seed multiplication centres and threshing floors for wheat, potato, legume and fodder crops based on the Institute of Plant and Agricultural Sciences; maintain a register of crop varieties and register seed, seedling and planting-stock producers and sellers for each crop, and establish an electronic database; provide support for the establishment of seed farms for the production of grain and fodder crop seeds; establish primary seed multiplication and variety testing centres to protect agricultural production from risks and to select crops and varieties suited to the region; establish at the national level four wheat, feed, 2 fodder, 5 vegetable, and 4 potato seed farms.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Plant genetic resources, seed production, crop variety testing, and agricultural production.",
"Target Audience": "The Plant and Agricultural Environment Institute / Institute of Plant and Agricultural Sciences; seed, seedling and planting-stock producers and sellers; seed farms.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "A national seed reserve for locally adapted varieties; a system for producing seeds of cereals, potatoes, vegetables, fruits, berries and other useful crops; establishment of 15 seed farms at the national level; crop variety registers and an electronic database; primary seed multiplication and variety testing centres; production of elite certified seeds; and scientifically based variety testing activities."
FSS_17:
"Goal/Purpose": "To ensure the agricultural production system in Mongolia adheres to technological documentation, introduces advanced technologies that reduce soil degradation, protect and improve soil fertility, applies proper crop rotation, and carries out technical and technological modernisation.",
"Action/Intervention": "Adhere to technological documentation; introduce advanced technologies for reducing soil degradation, protecting and improving soil fertility, and ensuring proper crop rotation; carry out technical and technological modernisation; provide tax support for machinery and equipment used in grain production by exempting them from customs duties and deferring tax payments; grant a 50 per cent discount on machinery purchased in the same year to improve mechanisation of potato and vegetable production and support technical and technological modernisation; provide support for the manufacture of small-scale equipment and working components.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Agricultural production in Mongolia, including grain, potato, and vegetable production.",
"Target Audience": "Agricultural producers in Mongolia, including grain, potato, and vegetable producers, as well as manufacturers of small-scale equipment and working components.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Improved adherence to technological documentation in agricultural production; increased use of advanced technologies; reduced soil degradation; protected and improved soil fertility; proper crop rotation; improved mechanisation of potato and vegetable production; and technical and technological modernisation in the agricultural sector."
FSS_18:
"Goal/Purpose": "Increase fodder cultivation and production, and raise the domestic supply of feed required for intensive livestock farming and auxiliary farms to 1.9 million tonnes.",
"Action/Intervention": "Provide organisational and financial support; provide preferential working capital loans to feed mills for the purchase of domestic raw materials.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Livestock farming, auxiliary farms, fodder cultivation and feed production.",
"Target Audience": "Feed mills, intensive livestock farming operations, and auxiliary farms.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Domestic supply of feed required for intensive livestock farming and auxiliary farms reaches 1.9 million tonnes."
FSS_19:
"Goal/Purpose": "To expand greenhouse cultivation to 270 hectares and ensure a stable, year-round supply of fresh produce for the population.",
"Action/Intervention": "Plan and implement policies and actions aimed at expanding greenhouse cultivation; establish a 50-hectare winter greenhouse complex in areas with adequate heating supply and infrastructure; establish a leasing system for the establishment of summer greenhouse farms; provide interest support; establish a 50-hectare greenhouse complex farm using advanced technology.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Greenhouse cultivation and fresh produce supply.",
"Target Audience": "The population.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Greenhouse cultivation expanded to 270 hectares; establishment of a 50-hectare winter greenhouse complex; stable, year-round supply of fresh produce."
FSS_20:
"Goal/Purpose": "To develop domestic fertiliser production to replenish soil nutrients and increase crop quality and yield, replace imports, and develop and implement the technical and economic feasibility of establishing nitrogen and phosphorus fertiliser plants based on mining enterprises to support exports.",
"Action/Intervention": "Research the reserves of raw materials for nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium fertilisers based on mining deposits; develop the technical and economic feasibility for establishing fertiliser production plants; establish nitrogen and phosphorus fertiliser plants based on mining enterprises; ensure their implementation; and provide fertiliser on preferential terms.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Agriculture, fertiliser production, and mining-based industrial development.",
"Target Audience": "Mining enterprises, fertiliser producers, and agricultural producers/crop growers.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Replenished soil nutrients, increased crop quality and yield, replacement of fertiliser imports, and support for fertiliser exports."
FSS_21:
"Goal/Purpose": "Increase the cultivation of all types of rice, sugar beet, and other cash crops, supported by financing, lending, and policy support.",
"Action/Intervention": "Increase the area of irrigated fields for the cultivation of all types of rice and sugar beet; establish an optimal system for financing and lending; provide policy support; focus on increasing the cultivation of rice, sugar beet, and other cash crops.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Agriculture, specifically irrigated crop cultivation and cash crop production.",
"Target Audience": "Producers and stakeholders involved in the cultivation of rice, sugar beet, and other cash crops.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Expanded irrigated field area for rice and sugar beet cultivation and increased cultivation of rice, sugar beet, and other cash crops with financing, lending, and policy support in place."
FSS_22:
"Goal/Purpose": "Increase regional storage capacity for grain, potatoes, and vegetables through expansion of standard-compliant grain elevators and mechanised warehouses and cellars.",
"Action/Intervention": "Increase the capacity of grain elevators meeting standard requirements by 20,000 tonnes and increase the capacity of mechanised warehouses and cellars for storing potatoes and vegetables by 50,000 tonnes on a regional basis; establish fully automated, mechanised potato and vegetable storage facilities with capacities of 500–2,500 tonnes each in the capital city and the 21 provinces; construct grain elevators in the western and eastern agricultural regions.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Agricultural storage infrastructure for grain, potatoes, and vegetables on a regional basis, including the capital city, the 21 provinces, and the western and eastern agricultural regions.",
"Target Audience": "Implementing entities responsible for agricultural storage infrastructure, and grain, potato, and vegetable producers and storage users in the capital city, provinces, and agricultural regions.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Capacity of grain elevators meeting standard requirements increased by 20,000 tonnes and capacity of mechanised warehouses and cellars for storing potatoes and vegetables increased by 50,000 tonnes, respectively, on a regional basis."
FSS_23:
"Goal/Purpose": "To overcome the risks of climate change and ensure the proper use and management of water.",
"Action/Intervention": "Introduce advanced, environmentally friendly irrigation technology; construct new irrigation systems; restore, renovate and refurbish irrigation systems; establish reservoirs, ponds and dams with basins; create the necessary financial resources and provide support for their construction; provide loans for equipment that enables the proper use and management of water by harvesting surface water, expanding irrigated vegetable plots and implementing technical and technological upgrades.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Irrigation and water management.",
"Target Audience": "Entities involved in irrigation system construction and rehabilitation, and recipients of loans for water management and irrigation equipment.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Proper use and management of water, harvesting of surface water, expanded irrigated vegetable plots, and technical and technological upgrades to irrigation systems."
FSS_24:
"Goal/Purpose": "Implement the ‘Billion Trees’ national movement through agroforestry establishment, fruit and berry seedling propagation, nursery enterprise development, and the creation of forest belts on agricultural fields.",
"Action/Intervention": "Establish 30 hectares of agroforestry in the provincial centre and 10 hectares in the district centre; establish a fruit and berry seedling propagation centre; develop nursery enterprises; fence off agricultural fields to establish forest belts; establish forest belts on agricultural fields; establish specialised fruit and berry farms; create a financing and incentive system; expand research and analysis; develop cultivation technologies; establish local centres for the propagation of fruit and berry seedlings; establish agroforestry enterprises in provinces and municipalities.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Agricultural fields, agroforestry areas, provincial and district centres, provinces and municipalities, and fruit and berry cultivation and propagation systems.",
"Target Audience": "Provinces, municipalities, provincial centres, district centres, nursery enterprises, agroforestry enterprises, and fruit and berry farms.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "30 hectares of agroforestry established in the provincial centre; 10 hectares of agroforestry established in the district centre; a fruit and berry seedling propagation centre established; local propagation centres established; nursery enterprises developed; forest belts established on agricultural fields; specialised fruit and berry farms established; financing and incentive systems created; research, analysis, and cultivation technologies expanded and developed; agroforestry enterprises established in provinces and municipalities; improved food security and increased exports."
FSS_25:
"Goal/Purpose": "Build strategic reserves of at least 100,000 tonnes of food and seed red wheat from each year's autumn harvest.",
"Action/Intervention": "Organise the establishment of a strategic reserve of no less than 100,000 tonnes of food and seed red wheat from each year's autumn harvest and establish a working capital fund.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Food and seed wheat reserves / agriculture",
"Target Audience": "Entities responsible for organising and establishing the strategic reserve and working capital fund; beneficiaries are those relying on food and seed red wheat reserves.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "A strategic reserve of at least 100,000 tonnes of food and seed red wheat is established from each year's autumn harvest, supported by a working capital fund."
FSS_26:
"Goal/Purpose": "To establish a proper ratio of livestock headcount to pasture capacity, protect animal health, increase the yield per animal, improve animal quality, and enhance the role and participation of herders.",
"Action/Intervention": "Collaborate with the administration and local authorities; segregate breeding and insemination stock and core herd sires and place them in a centralised location for expert supervision; determine livestock productivity indicators and establish an integrated database through inspections, classifications, individual tagging and registration, and genetic evaluations; determine and evaluate the status of livestock genetic resources and take remedial action; improve the utilisation and protection of pastures; increase the reserves of grazing land, water, fodder and feed.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Livestock and pasture management.",
"Target Audience": "Administration, local authorities, and herders.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "A proper livestock headcount-to-pasture-capacity ratio established; animal health protected; yield per animal increased; animal quality improved; herder role and participation enhanced; livestock productivity indicators and an integrated database established; livestock genetic resources evaluated and remedial action taken; utilisation and protection of pastures improved; reserves of grazing land, water, fodder and feed increased."
FSS_27:
"Goal/Purpose": "To develop target markets for livestock and livestock raw materials, establish an optimal supply chain for procurement, primary processing and marketing, and establish and modernise model cooperatives while supporting the cooperative movement.",
"Action/Intervention": "Develop target markets for livestock and livestock raw materials; establish an optimal supply chain for procurement, primary processing and marketing; establish and modernise model cooperatives; support the cooperative movement in all respects; establish model cooperatives for livestock, livestock products, supply, primary processing and sales; provide small-scale equipment required for household enterprises and sales support.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Livestock sector, including livestock raw materials, procurement, primary processing, marketing, supply, sales, and cooperatives.",
"Target Audience": "Model cooperatives, the cooperative movement, and household enterprises involved in livestock, livestock products, supply, primary processing and sales.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Target markets are developed for livestock and livestock raw materials; an optimal supply chain for procurement, primary processing and marketing is established; model cooperatives are established and modernised; the cooperative movement is supported; and household enterprises receive small-scale equipment and sales support."
FSS_28:
"Goal/Purpose": "To develop intensive livestock farming near towns and settlements and in agricultural regions; establish core breeding flocks for meat and fine-wool sheep; protect livestock gene pools; intensify breeding and technological work; support the operations of units in this field; and provide the necessary budget funding.",
"Action/Intervention": "Provide support for intensive beef and dairy farms in urban, settlement and agricultural areas; provide loans and interest rate support to operators of intensive dairy farms; provide loans and interest support to operators of intensive meat-focused farms; support the establishment of core breeding flocks for meat and fine-wool sheep; import high-yield animal embryos from abroad under a unified policy; introduce biotechnological advances into breeding and selection work; protect livestock genetic resources; intensify breeding and technological work; support the operations of units in this field; and include the necessary funding in the budget.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Livestock farming and animal breeding in urban, settlement, and agricultural areas.",
"Target Audience": "Operators of intensive dairy farms, operators of intensive meat-focused farms, units working in livestock breeding and technological work, and sheep breeding operations establishing core breeding flocks.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Development of intensive livestock farming with 50.0 thousand head of beef-oriented breeds and 50.0 thousand head of dairy-oriented breeds; establishment of core breeding flocks for meat and fine-wool sheep; import of high-yield animal embryos from abroad under a unified policy; introduction of biotechnological advances into breeding and selection work; protection of livestock gene pools; intensified breeding and technological work; operational support for relevant units; and budget funding for these activities."
FSS_29:
"Goal/Purpose": "Increase enterprise participation in the expansion and establishment of pig, poultry, and fattening lamb and cattle farms through long-term investment and financial support.",
"Action/Intervention": "Provide long-term investment and financial support; provide pig farmers with preferential loan support; provide tax support for the poultry industry by exempting equipment from customs duties and deferring tax payments; support and develop meat cattle and sheep fattening farms by increasing regional and local involvement.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Livestock and meat production sector, specifically pig, poultry, lamb, sheep, and cattle farming.",
"Target Audience": "Enterprises participating in pig, poultry, and fattening lamb and cattle farms; pig farmers; poultry industry operators; meat cattle and sheep fattening farms; regional and local actors involved in support.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Expanded and newly established pig, poultry, and fattening lamb and cattle farms, with increased enterprise participation supported by investment, loans, tax measures, and regional and local involvement."
FSS_30:
"Goal/Purpose": "To develop beekeeping as a co-operative enterprise, increase its product output, and create opportunities for export.",
"Action/Intervention": "Organise beekeepers into clusters based on regionalisation and cooperation; support them through policy; develop them by leveraging the activities of professional associations; provide preferential loan support to phase out honey imports and increase exports of honey with geographical indications.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Beekeeping and honey production",
"Target Audience": "Beekeepers, co-operatives, professional associations",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Beekeeping developed as a co-operative enterprise; increased product output; opportunities for export created; honey imports phased out; exports of honey with geographical indications increased."
FSS_31:
"Goal/Purpose": "To swiftly implement comprehensive measures to combat highly contagious diseases in livestock and animals.",
"Action/Intervention": "Implement comprehensive measures to combat highly contagious/highly pathogenic diseases in livestock and animals; introduce advanced biopreparate production/technologies; expand and modernise the operations of ‘Biocombinat’ LLC; vaccinate all susceptible livestock and animals twice a year; establish a vaccine cold chain network; strengthen the veterinary diagnostic laboratory; strengthen the operations of veterinary service units; include the necessary funding in national and local budgets.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Livestock and animal health; veterinary services.",
"Target Audience": "Veterinary service units, veterinary diagnostic laboratory, ‘Biocombinat’ LLC, national and local budget authorities, and livestock and animal holders/owners.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Strengthened capacity to prevent, diagnose, and respond to highly contagious diseases in livestock and animals through vaccination, cold chain establishment, improved laboratory capacity, stronger veterinary service operations, advanced biopreparate production, and allocated funding."
FSS_32:
"Goal/Purpose": "To refine the incentive system for domestically processed products that meet domestic market quality, hygiene and safety standards, and for products manufactured from food raw materials supplied by livestock farming and agriculture.",
"Action/Intervention": "Process domestically the raw materials supplied by livestock farming and agriculture; manufacture finished products; award incentives for products sold on the domestic market that meet quality, hygiene and safety standards; establish and create the legal framework and regulations for providing incentives for products that meet quality and safety standards; channel traceable, healthy livestock to abattoirs and raw milk to dairy processing plants; develop and approve regulations for providing incentives and support to herders and intensive livestock farmers who supply eggs, pork and chicken meat.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Livestock farming, agriculture, domestic food processing, and domestic food market standards.",
"Target Audience": "Domestic processors of livestock and agricultural raw materials; producers of finished food products; herders; intensive livestock farmers; suppliers of eggs, pork, chicken meat, livestock, and raw milk.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Domestically processed and manufactured food products receive incentives when they meet domestic market quality, hygiene and safety standards; a legal and regulatory framework for such incentives is established; traceable, healthy livestock are supplied to abattoirs and raw milk to dairy processing plants; incentives and support are provided to herders and intensive livestock farmers supplying eggs, pork and chicken meat."
FSS_33:
"Goal/Purpose": "To provide financial support for the establishment and expansion of new factories for children's food, milk, vegetables, fruits, and fruit-based feeds, and for the domestic procurement and supply of their primary raw materials.",
"Action/Intervention": "Provide financial and preferential loan support for: the establishment and expansion of factories for children's food, milk, vegetables, fruits, and fruit-based feeds; the domestic procurement and supply of primary raw materials; establishing a processing plant for vegetables, fruits and berries for children's meals and food consumption; establishing a plant to process milk and dairy feed for children; establishing a ready-made, import-replacing product factory for children; and establishing a local milk processing plant for the production of curd, butter and milk for school and nursery children.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Food processing and manufacturing sector for children's food and dairy products.",
"Target Audience": "Factories and processing plants producing children's food and dairy products; school and nursery children.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Establishment and expansion of new factories and processing plants for children's food and dairy products, and domestic procurement and supply of their primary raw materials."
FSS_34:
"Goal/Purpose": "To increase the meal allowances for pupils in nurseries, state schools, vocational education and training institutions, and in boarding houses in line with nutritional requirements and the rate of inflation, and ensure the supervision and involvement of parents and guardians.",
"Action/Intervention": "Transition to a principle of shared responsibility for nursery children's meal costs between the state, parents and guardians; take measures to increase meal allowances to ensure adequate calorie and nutritional content; establish the necessary legal framework to transition per-child funding for nursery children's meals and primary school pupils' lunches to cost-based financing in line with inflation levels, taking into account nutritional quality; establish an electronic system for the integrated management and provision of food production and service for nursery and school children; support, through incentive, tax and other policy measures, the establishment of an electronic integrated management and supply system for the production and service of meals in nursery and school dormitories, including supply of factory-prepared meat, vegetables, milk and dairy products, flour, semi-finished products and ingredients to enterprises.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Education and child nutrition/meal provision in nurseries, state schools, vocational education and training institutions, boarding houses, and dormitories.",
"Target Audience": "Pupils in nurseries, state schools, vocational education and training institutions, and boarding houses; nursery and primary school children; parents and guardians; enterprises involved in meal production and supply.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Meal allowances increased in line with nutritional requirements and inflation; adequate calorie and nutritional content of meals ensured; per-child meal funding transitioned to cost-based financing in line with inflation; supervision and involvement of parents and guardians ensured; electronic integrated management and supply systems for meal production and service established and supported."
FSS_35:
"Goal/Purpose": "Establish a system to provide financial support for the new establishment of processing plants for dry milk, table salt, edible oils, potatoes, various types of rice and sugar.",
"Action/Intervention": "Provide financial support for establishing new processing plants, including: establishment of a factory to process 20.0 thousand litres of liquid milk per day and produce milk powder; establishment of a factory to process 15 tonnes of edible salt per day; establishment of a potato processing plant for the production of starch and potato products; and establishment of a sugar refinery.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Food processing and agro-processing sector.",
"Target Audience": "Entities establishing new processing plants for dry milk, table salt, edible oils, potatoes, various types of rice and sugar.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "A system for financial support is established, enabling the new establishment of processing plants for the specified products, including milk powder, edible salt, potato products, and sugar refining."
FSS_36:
"Goal/Purpose": "To establish a new fleet of specialised food transport vehicles (road, rail and air) and create a system for transporting domestic and imported food raw materials and products.",
"Action/Intervention": "Establish a unified electronic database and system for the registration and management of food transport, logistics, and cargo turnover; provide support through lending and tax policies to increase the availability of specialised food transport vehicles; support the establishment of a fleet of specialised food transport vehicles; create a legal framework; create a system for transporting domestic and imported food raw materials and products.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Food transport, logistics, and cargo turnover system for domestic and imported food raw materials and products.",
"Target Audience": "Food transport and logistics actors involved in the transport of domestic and imported food raw materials and products.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "A new fleet of specialised food transport vehicles is established, and a system for transporting domestic and imported food raw materials and products is created."
FSS_37:
"Goal/Purpose": "To improve the storage and preservation of food raw materials and products through specialised facilities, a unified registration system, support for drying, freezing and preserving equipment, and domestic production of food containers and packaging.",
"Action/Intervention": "Store food raw materials and products in specialised warehouses and storages that meet standard requirements; establish a unified registration system, including a unified electronic database and storage system for food raw materials and products in purpose-built warehouses and storerooms; support the supply of small and medium-sized equipment for drying, freezing and preserving; provide tax support by exempting food processing machinery and equipment from customs duties and deferring tax payments; support the establishment of factories for producing plastic crates for the storage and transport of vegetables, as well as wooden seedbeds and plant nursery pots; develop domestic production of food containers and packaging.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Food storage, food processing, and food packaging.",
"Target Audience": "Food raw material and product storage operators, food processing machinery and equipment suppliers, and domestic manufacturers of food containers and packaging.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Food raw materials and products are stored in facilities that meet standard requirements; a unified electronic registration and storage database/system is established; small and medium-sized drying, freezing and preserving equipment is supported; tax support is provided for food processing machinery and equipment; and domestic production of plastic crates, wooden seedbeds, plant nursery pots, food containers, and packaging is developed."
FSS_38:
"Goal/Purpose": "To fully utilise the capacity of food processing plants and improve product flavour and quality, packaging and containers, product variety, export-oriented branding, and stable factory operations.",
"Action/Intervention": "Modernise food processing equipment; improve packaging and containers; increase product variety; create and develop export-oriented brands and products; support the stable operation of food processing plants with working capital.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Food processing sector.",
"Target Audience": "Food processing plants and factories.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Improved product flavour and quality; improved packaging and containers; increased product variety; development of export-oriented brands and products; stable factory operations; full utilisation of food processing plant capacity."
FSS_39:
"Goal/Purpose": "Increase production of dietary supplements, biologically active food products, and functional foods.",
"Action/Intervention": "Provide policy support to increase dietary supplements, biologically active food products, and functional foods, and support their production.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Food production and food products sector.",
"Target Audience": "Producers of dietary supplements, biologically active food products, and functional foods.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Increased production of dietary supplements, biologically active food products, and functional foods."
FSS_40:
"Goal/Purpose": "To fully define food safety indicators nationwide and establish a system for pre-shipment laboratory analysis and inspection of exported and imported food raw materials and products.",
"Action/Intervention": "Modernise laboratory analysis and testing methodologies nationwide; fully define food safety parameters; provide technical expertise and equipment support; establish and conduct pre-shipment laboratory testing, monitoring and inspection of imported and exported food raw materials and products; amend the legal framework; strengthen border and national accredited laboratories; strengthen human resources and create stable working conditions.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Food safety, laboratory analysis and inspection of food raw materials and products.",
"Target Audience": "Border laboratories, national accredited laboratories, and human resources involved in laboratory analysis, inspection, and food safety implementation.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Nationwide food safety indicators are fully defined; a pre-shipment laboratory analysis and inspection system for exported and imported food raw materials and products is established; border and national accredited laboratories are strengthened."
FSS_41:
